investigation_notes.Description: The PowerShell script enumerates Active Directory OUs, associated GPO links, linked computers, groups, and users, then converts the results to JSON and writes the output to an agent-specific path. Key observations: the script is plaintext (no obfuscation), runs as the SYSTEM account, uses standard AD cmdlets, and references 'CyberCNSAgent' installation directories. Because the behavior aligns with benign inventory/collection activity, references an identified agent path, and executes under a service context, this alert is assessed as Low Priority.
investigation_notes.Script Summary: Enumerates AD Organizational Units, GPO inheritance/links, linked computers/groups/users, converts to JSON, and writes to disk.
investigation_notes.Admin Marker Found: References to C:\Program Files (x86)\CyberCNSAgent and C:\Windows\cybercnsagent agent_temp paths
